mapper.sql: ID, ACTION, PRIORITY, STATUS, PARK_ID, SOURCE_TYPE, SOURCE_ID, BADGE, PERSON_ID, CARD_NO, ACTIVE_KEY, LEASE_TOKEN, RUNNING_KEY, CODE, REMARK, CONSUME, TIMES, OVER_TIME, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME, OPT_USER
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT FROM SMT_ISC_CARD_TASK WHERE (STATUS IN (0, 3) OR STATUS IS NULL) AND OVER_TIME <= #{currentTime} AND (CODE != 200 OR CODE IS NULL) AND (TIMES IS NULL OR TIMES < #{maxRetryTimes}) ORDER BY NVL(PRIORITY, 0) DESC, OVER_TIME ASC, CREATE_TIME ASC, TIMES ASC, ID ASC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 500
mapper.update: UPDATE SMT_ISC_CARD_TASK CURRENT_TASK SET STATUS = 3, RUNNING_KEY = #{runningKey}, LEASE_TOKEN = #{leaseToken}, OVER_TIME = #{doingDeadlineTime}, UPDATE_TIME = #{updateTime} WHERE CURRENT_TASK.ID = #{id} AND ( ((CURRENT_TASK.STATUS = 0 OR CURRENT_TASK.STATUS IS NULL) AND CURRENT_TASK.OVER_TIME <= #{currentTime}) OR (CURRENT_TASK.STATUS = 3 AND CURRENT_TASK.OVER_TIME <= #{currentTime}) ) AND (CURRENT_TASK.CODE != 200 OR CURRENT_TASK.CODE IS NULL) AND (CURRENT_TASK.TIMES IS NULL OR CURRENT_TASK.TIMES < #{maxRetryTimes}) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM SMT_ISC_CARD_TASK BLOCK_TASK WHERE BLOCK_TASK.ID != CURRENT_TASK.ID AND NVL(BLOCK_TASK.SOURCE_TYPE, ' ') = NVL(CURRENT_TASK.SOURCE_TYPE, ' ') AND NVL(BLOCK_TASK.SOURCE_ID, -1) = NVL(CURRENT_TASK.SOURCE_ID, -1) AND NVL(BLOCK_TASK.PRIORITY, 0) > NVL(CURRENT_TASK.PRIORITY, 0) AND (BLOCK_TASK.STATUS IN (0, 3) OR BLOCK_TASK.STATUS IS NULL) AND (BLOCK_TASK.CODE != 200 OR BLOCK_TASK.CODE IS NULL) )
